records.reason: The Discussion explicitly relates the present study’s results to Eikeseth et al. (2007): it reports greater improvement for EIBI than services as usual across outcome measures, and says results support findings for children starting EIBI at ages 4–6. The reference list identifies the 2007 empirical report. The only supplied shipped row is Cohen et al. (2006), a separate community-setting study and not the Eikeseth age-at-onset report.
records.omission_quote:
In addition, given the
wide age range of our sample, the results also support previous findings that
some children who are 4 to 6 years old at onset of EIBI can make substantial
gains in IQ, adaptive behavior, and school placement (Eikeseth et al., 2007).
